notFound: Harvey Norman Ireland: its collections feed and its washing machine category page both answered HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare 'Just a moment' challenge, so no Harvey Norman model or price was read.
Currys Ireland: the washing machine listing answered HTTP 403 (Cloudflare 'Attention Required'), so nothing from Currys was read, including its LG, Logik and Kenwood ranges.

Power City: the washing machine group page (63 items) gives only truncated names and Power City's own product codes, never the manufacturer model number, so no Power City offers were recorded and its dryer and dishwasher pages were not fetched.
Miele Ireland (miele.ie): the washing machine category page answered HTTP 403, so Miele models and prices come from retailer pages only and Miele's own prices were not read.

bosch-home.ie, beko.ie and hotpoint.ie: the listing pages read (Bosch front loaders, Beko washing machines page 1, Hotpoint washing machines) show model numbers but no prices ('Where to buy'), so models found only there were left out.

Samsung Ireland (the all-washing-machines path returned 404) and LG Ireland (own site not located) were not read, so Samsung and LG models come from retailer pages only, and LG appears only at Arnotts because Harvey Norman and Currys were blocked.
Expert Ireland: its freestanding washer dryer category says 'There are no products listed under this category', so Expert has no washer dryer offers.

Euronics Ireland: collections/tumble-dryers returned no products, so its dryers were read from the laundry and heat-pump-dryers collections, and its collection counts (133 dishwashers, 321 laundry) exceed what its products feed returned (56 and 79), so some Euronics models may be missing.

EPREL: no listing page read, and the one Joyce's product page checked, shows an EPREL number or an eprel.ec.europa.eu/qr link (Joyce's energy label files carry a seven-digit number such as 2280600 that is not labelled as EPREL), so eprel is null for every product.
Model year is not stated on any page read, so year is null for every product.

Where a page showed a regular price above a lower sale price (Joyce's 'was', Expert 'Was', Euronics, Ganlys and Keans compare-at, Arnotts 'Was/Now') the regular price was recorded, and no product needed a sale-only price.

fuel is 'electric' for every dryer because no gas tumble dryer is sold in Ireland and the pages give kWh figures, and dryerType is set only where a title or spec says heat pump, condenser or vented, with heat pump winning where retailers disagree (Samsung DV90CGC0A0AEEU and DV90DG6845LBU1).
loadType is 'front' only where a title says front loading or a page states a width of 55 cm or more, and is null where the listing gave neither.
For washer dryers capacityKg is the washing capacity (9 of 9/6kg) because the schema has no field for the drying capacity.

Model codes written differently by different pages were treated as one product (Miele with or without the WCS or WPS suffix, Whirlpool, Hotpoint and Indesit with or without UK or IRE, spacing and hyphen differences, Belling BFW712WH, Miele G5611SCACTIVE and G5811SC-CLST), and four retailer typos or truncations were folded into the real code (Arnotts DW6OU4HI2 for DW60U4HI2, Joyce's SMV4HVXOO for SMV4HVX00G and WQG245RIGB for WQG245R1GB, Ganlys WOM27WADS for W0M27WADS and W899ADUK for W8 99AD SILENCE UK).

Left out as unreadable, contradictory or not a single appliance: Joyce's Hotpoint washer dryer titled 'Graphite | NDB 9635 W UK' with SKU NDB9635GKUK, Keans' Miele G 5811 SC CleanSteel listed only by material number 12864970, Keans' ex-display Miele WEG665, the LG WashTower WT1210BBTN1 stack, and stacking kits, plinths and detergents.
Listings flagged unavailable or out of stock (Joyce's 111, Euronics 94, DID 43 and Ganlys 33 records) were kept at the price shown, since each page still lists the model as current range.

Maker sites for Samsung, LG, Hisense, Haier, Candy, Hoover, Zanussi, AEG, Electrolux, Smeg and Whirlpool were not fetched within the fetch budget, so those brands are covered only as far as the seven retailer listings carried them.
